core.title: Commercial Entry Set GR2 Drive-In-Latch, Deltana G2DLE

text.description_html:
Deltana G2DLE, Commercial Keyed Entry Drive-In-Latch

The Entry Set GR2 Drive-In-Latch is easy to install as it just requires bore hole and cross bore. Because there is no faceplate, there is nothing to mortise, that means you won't have to chisel anything out of your door. To install, just tap the latch into the hole. These Deltana G2DLE Drive-In-Latches will work with commercial Keyed Entry Function Sets like Deltana Grade 1 and 2 Levers, Global Keyed Entry Sets, PDQ SV Series Levers. Available for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets.

Features and Specifications of the GR2 Commercial Drive-In-Latch Entry:

  • Material: Stainless Steel / Zinc
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Latch Bolt Length: 1/2"
  • Available for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets.
  • For Keyed Entry Functions.
  • Deltana G2DLE Drive in Latch Specifications (PDF)

*For Commercial Cylindrical type leversets only.
